title: Hong Kong International Airport – To and from the airport
claims: Hong Kong International Airport offers the Airport Express, which the airport describes as the quickest way to and from the city.
Public buses from Hong Kong International Airport serve all of Hong Kong.
Taxis are listed as a way to reach destinations from Hong Kong International Airport.
